"""Backend API tests for core run and participant behaviors.

Covers create, list, detail, join, duplicate-join, leave, and leave-unknown
scenarios against the FastAPI app via the scaffold-provided ``client`` fixture.
"""

import pytest

from backend.store import reset


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _clean_state():
    """Reset all in-memory stores before every test for order-independence."""
    reset()
    yield


def _create_run(client, **overrides):
    """Helper: POST a valid run and return the response."""
    payload = {
        "title": "Morning 5K",
        "datetime": "2026-09-01 07:00",
        "location": "Riverside Park",
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return client.post("/runs", json=payload)


def test_create_run_and_list(client):
    """POST /runs with valid fields returns 201; the run appears in GET /runs."""
    resp = _create_run(client)
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"]
    assert body["title"] == "Morning 5K"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2026-09-01 07:00"
    assert body["location"] == "Riverside Park"
    assert body["participants"] == []

    # Verify the run appears in the list
    list_resp = client.get("/runs")
    assert list_resp.status_code == 200
    runs = list_resp.json()
    assert len(runs) == 1
    assert runs[0]["id"] == body["id"]
    assert runs[0]["title"] == "Morning 5K"
    assert runs[0]["participant_count"] == 0


def test_create_run_missing_required_field(client):
    """POST /runs without 'location' returns 422 validation_error."""
    resp = client.post(
        "/runs",
        json={"title": "Test Run", "datetime": "2026-09-01 07:00"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


def test_join_run_valid(client):
    """POST /runs/{id}/join with a valid name adds the participant."""
    create = _create_run(client)
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    join_resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Alice"})
    assert join_resp.status_code == 200
    body = join_resp.json()
    names = [p["name"] for p in body["participants"]]
    assert "Alice" in names
    assert len(body["participants"]) == 1


def test_join_run_duplicate_name(client):
    """POST /runs/{id}/join with a duplicate name (case-insensitive) returns 409."""
    create = _create_run(client)
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    # First join succeeds
    first = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Alice"})
    assert first.status_code == 200

    # Duplicate with different casing should be rejected
    dup_resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "alice"})
    assert dup_resp.status_code == 409
    body = dup_resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "duplicate_participant"


def test_leave_run_valid(client):
    """POST /runs/{id}/leave with a valid name removes the participant."""
    create = _create_run(client)
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    # Join first
    client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Bob"})

    # Leave
    leave_resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert leave_resp.status_code == 200
    body = leave_resp.json()
    assert len(body["participants"]) == 0


def test_leave_run_unknown_name(client):
    """POST /runs/{id}/leave with an unknown name returns 404 participant_not_found."""
    create = _create_run(client)
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    leave_resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Nobody"})
    assert leave_resp.status_code == 404
    body = leave_resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "participant_not_found"


def test_get_run_by_valid_id(client):
    """GET /runs/{id} returns the full run with all expected fields."""
    create = _create_run(
        client,
        distance="5K",
        pace_target="9:00/mi",
        route_notes="Flat loop",
    )
    run_id = create.json()["id"]

    detail_resp = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}")
    assert detail_resp.status_code == 200
    body = detail_resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == run_id
    assert body["title"] == "Morning 5K"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2026-09-01 07:00"
    assert body["location"] == "Riverside Park"
    assert body["distance"] == "5K"
    assert body["pace_target"] == "9:00/mi"
    assert body["route_notes"] == "Flat loop"
    assert "participants" in body


def test_get_run_unknown_id(client):
    """GET /runs/{id} with an unknown id returns 404 run_not_found."""
    resp = client.get("/runs/does-not-exist")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["error"]["code"] == "run_not_found"
